concepts.gloss_en: freedom/liberty (release from servitude; ben chorin, freedom tied to the covenant, freedom of Shabbat/Pesach)

reason_for_human: All occurrences are the noun חֵרוּת 'freedom' (lm1:31 'הַחֵרוּת תְּלוּיָה בַּבְּרִית'; lm2:17 'בְּשַׁבָּת הוּא חֵרוּת' — no servitude/exile). לחרות is just the same word with the lamed prefix ('to freedom'), an inflection, not a homograph. The lm2:74 token (partner מרדכי, Purim→Pesach theme) is not fully visible in the excerpt but fits the same freedom sense; note it is NOT the homograph חָרוּת 'engraved', which would pair with לוחות rather than מרדכי.
